active_storage.name: U-drive and O-drive
active_storage.Purpose: Standard service for UU staff and students for storing and sharing files. O-Drive: common storage for faculties, services and departments. U- Drive: Personal storage for UU staff and students.
active_storage.How to access: Desktops at UU have the drives automatically available. Outside of the UU network, you can use VPN (vpn.uu.nl) to have a local copy of your U/O-drive cached to your device, or use SolisWorkspace (https://manuals.uu.nl/en/a-z/?_tags=solisworkspace)
active_storage.Sharing and Collaboration:
U-drive: no
O-drive: internal sharing only (university access)
active_storage.Storage capacity:
U Drive: 0.1 TB (extension possible on request via ITS Servicedesk)
O-Drive: Unlimited
active_storage.Data sensitivity classification: Basic. Only sensitive if access is controlled
active_storage.Back-ups & Recovery: Back-ups are done twice a day. Back-ups are retained for 7 years. Maximum data loss is 16 hours.
active_storage.Versioning: It is possible to restore earlier versions up to 1 month back.
active_storage.Complete data deletion: Not possible: data still present in snapshot (and possibly back-up)
active_storage.Costs and eligibility: Free for students and staff (31,- per TB per month)
active_storage.Longterm storage: Not for preservation, intended for Active Data

active_storage.name: OneDrive for Business
active_storage.Purpose: Microsoft 365 solution for storing and sharing personal business files in the cloud. You are the only one with access to these files, but access can be granted to colleagues or external people.
active_storage.How to access: Accessible from anywhere with internet access and institutional login via the browser or OneDrive client.
active_storage.Sharing and Collaboration: Internal and external sharing (through email address)
active_storage.File formats: File extensions not supported in OneDrive: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/restrictions-and-limitations-in-onedrive-and-sharepoint-64883a5d-228e-48f5-b3d2-eb39e07630fa
active_storage.Data sensitivity classification: Basic. Only sensitive if access is controlled.
active_storage.Back-ups & Recovery: Local recovery and version control. Ensure the Sync setting is on to back-up after every 10 minutes. Files can be recovered up to 93 days after deletion.
active_storage.Versioning: Ensure File versioning is on in your One Drive instance. Can store upto to 100 versions of a single file.
active_storage.Longterm storage: Not for preservation, intended for Active Data

active_storage.name: UU Sharepoint & Microsoft Teams
active_storage.Purpose: Microsoft Teams is part of Office 365 and offers an integrated collaboration environment. Store and share files with your team, edit documents with multiple people at the same time, chat with your colleagues, schedule online video calls, organize live events and make use of extra tools like a Wiki or Planner. Files in a Teams environment can also be accessed via Sharepoint. Teamsire Extra Secure is similair to a regular Teamsite, but more closed. For example it’s not possible to synchronize files locally or to share files with external people.
active_storage.How to access: Accessible from anywhere with internet access and institutional login via the browser, Teams application or OneDrive client.
active_storage.Sharing and Collaboration: Internal and external sharing (through email address). Teamsite Secure can only be shared internally.
active_storage.Storage capacity:
Teams: 1 TB
Teamsite / Teamsite Secure: 5 GB, expandable to 1 TB
active_storage.File formats: File extensions not supported in Teams and Sharepoint: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/restrictions-and-limitations-in-onedrive-and-sharepoint-64883a5d-228e-48f5-b3d2-eb39e07630fa
active_storage.Data sensitivity classification:
Teamsite: Basic, sensitive if WebDAV is used on managed devices only, data are shared validated accounts and access is controlled.
Teamsite Secure: Sensitive, critical under specific conditions
Teams: Basic, sensitive under specific conditions
active_storage.Versioning: Ensure versioning is enabled in your Sharepoint site or library
active_storage.Longterm storage: Not for preservation, intended for Active Data
active_storage.Has search interface: You can search through open Sharepoint sites within UU: https://solisservices.sharepoint.com/SitePages/Home.aspx

active_storage.name: Yoda
active_storage.Purpose: Open source research data management service that enables Utrecht University researchers and their partners to collaborate on, preserve and publish research data.
active_storage.How to access:
Via the browser: https://www.uu.nl/en/research/yoda/guide-to-yoda/i-want-to-start-using-yoda/i-want-to-log-in
Via the Yoda Network disk: https://www.uu.nl/en/research/yoda/guide-to-yoda/i-want-to-start-using-yoda
active_storage.Sharing and Collaboration: Internal and external sharing. Access levels during publication: public, restricted, closed
active_storage.Storage capacity: Differs per research group. In principle more than 10 TB is possible. Usually additional costs are involved when storing over 1 TB of data.
active_storage.Maximum File size: Unlimited. Recommended to use icommands for big datasets: https://www.uu.nl/en/research/yoda/guide-to-yoda/i-am-using-yoda/using-icommands-for-large-datasets
active_storage.File formats: All file formats accepted, but please use preferred file formats: https://dans.knaw.nl/en/file-formats/
active_storage.Data sensitivity classification: Basic. Sensitive or critical under additional conditions
active_storage.Back-ups & Recovery: Unlimited back-up in the vault. A new revision of your data is saved every time you save a file using the same name. Revisions are retained for a maximum of 117 days.
active_storage.Versioning: A maximum of one revision per 60 seconds is made. Revisions are retained for a maximum of 117 days.
active_storage.Costs and eligibility: 4,- per TB per month. Some faculties cover the fair use of Yoda for their employees.
active_storage.Longterm storage: Intended for active data, long-term preservation in the vault (min. 10 years) and publication
active_storage.Metadata: Datacite v4. It is possible to use discipline-specific json-formatted metadata
active_storage.Search engines harvesting?: Yes, metadata can be harvested via an OAI-PMH endpoint and is harvested by DataCite and the Netherlands Research Portal (OpenAire).
active_storage.Aggregated to search service: Metadata are harvested by DataCite and the Netherlands Research Portal (OpenAire)
active_storage.Data citation: Each data package receives a DOI which can be used to refer to the data package.

active_storage.name: SURFDrive
active_storage.Purpose: Personal cloud storage service for the Dutch education and research community, offering staff, researchers and students an easy way to store, synchronise and share files in the secure and reliable SURF community cloud.
active_storage.How to access: Via the web browser (institutional login) or OwnCloud application (dekstop/mobile)
active_storage.Sync to Client: Yes, via Webdav. It is possible to exclude files from being synchronized (Programs > General > Edit > Excluded files > Add > Type the name of the file you wish to exclude from synchronisation > select > OK)
active_storage.Sharing and Collaboration: Internal and external. Easy sharing with other participating institutions via the SURF Federated Cloud ID.
active_storage.File encryption: No, but possible to use third-party tooling.
active_storage.Back-ups & Recovery: Manually restore deleted files until max. 30 days. Maximum data loss 1 month.
active_storage.Versioning: Earlier versions are stored everytime you upload a new file and retained for 14 days.
active_storage.Costs and eligibility: Free for employees from participating institutions
active_storage.Longterm storage: Not for preservation, intended for Active Data

active_storage.name: UU Research Drive
active_storage.Purpose: Cloud storage service for teams from the Dutch education and research community. It is the team-variant of SURFdrive.
active_storage.How to access: Via the web browser (institutional login) or OwnCloud application (dekstop/mobile)
active_storage.Sync to Client: Yes, via Webdav. It is possible to exclude files from being synchronized (Programs > General > Edit > Excluded files > Add > Type the name of the file you wish to exclude from synchronisation > select > OK)
active_storage.Sharing and Collaboration: Internal and external. Easy sharing with other participating institutions via the SURF Federated Cloud ID.
active_storage.File encryption: No, but works well with Cryptomator.
active_storage.Back-ups & Recovery: Files are retained for a maximum of 90 days.
active_storage.Versioning: Earlier versions are stored everytime you upload a new file and retained for 14 days.
active_storage.Costs and eligibility: Free for employees from participating institutions
active_storage.Longterm storage: Not for preservation, intended for Active Data

active_storage.name: ITS Basic Storage
active_storage.Storage type: ITS Basic storage is a storage solution for storing large amounts of data for a relatiavely low price. It is possible to access the storage via either O:\Research of O:\Archive (depending on the type of data).
active_storage.Sync to Client: ITS Basic storage is a storage solution for storing large amounts of data for a relatiavely low price. It is possible to access the storage via either O:\Research of O:\Archive (depending on the type of data).
active_storage.Sharing and Collaboration: Yes, within UU. Access is controlled by the owner of the fileshare.
active_storage.Data sensitivity classification: basic, sensitive if access rights are controlled

preservation_storage.name: Yoda
preservation_storage.Purpose: Open source research data management service that enables Utrecht University researchers and their partners to collaborate on, preserve and publish research data.
preservation_storage.How to access:
Via the browser: https://www.uu.nl/en/research/yoda/guide-to-yoda/i-want-to-start-using-yoda/i-want-to-log-in
Via the Yoda Network disk: https://www.uu.nl/en/research/yoda/guide-to-yoda/i-want-to-start-using-yoda
preservation_storage.Sharing and Collaboration: Internal and external sharing. Access levels during publication: public, restricted, closed
preservation_storage.Storage capacity: Differs per research group. In principle more than 10 TB is possible. Usually additional costs are involved when storing over 1 TB of data.
preservation_storage.Maximum File size: Unlimited. Recommended to use icommands for big datasets: https://shorturl.at/eqA29
preservation_storage.File formats: All file formats accepted, but please use preferred file formats: https://dans.knaw.nl/en/file-formats/
preservation_storage.Data sensitivity classification: Basic. Sensitive or critical under additional conditions
preservation_storage.Back-ups & Recovery: Unlimited back-up in the vault. A new revision of your data is saved every time you save a file using the same name. Revisions are retained for a maximum of 117 days.
preservation_storage.Versioning: A maximum of one revision per 60 seconds is made. Revisions are retained for a maximum of 117 days.
preservation_storage.Costs and eligibility: 4,- per TB per month. Some faculties cover the fair use of Yoda for their employees.
preservation_storage.Longterm storage: Intended for active data, long-term preservation in the vault (min. 10 years) and publication
preservation_storage.Metadata: Datacite v4. It is possible to use discipline-specific json-formatted metadata
preservation_storage.Search engines harvesting?: Yes, metadata can be harvested via an OAI-PMH endpoint and is harvested by DataCite and the Netherlands Research Portal (OpenAire).
preservation_storage.Aggregated to search service: Metadata are harvested by DataCite and the Netherlands Research Portal (OpenAire)
preservation_storage.Data citation: Each data package receives a DOI which can be used to refer to the data package.

preservation_storage.name: DataverseNL
preservation_storage.Storage type: Data repository for data archiving and publication
preservation_storage.Purpose: A data repository co-provided by DANS and participating institutions for curating and publishing research data.
preservation_storage.How to access: Via the web browser (using institutional log-in, username/password, Microsoft Azure AD, GitHub or Google). DataverseNL also has an API that you can interact with.
preservation_storage.Sharing and Collaboration: External sharing. Access levels: public, restricted (on request), private URL
preservation_storage.Storage capacity: 10 GB, although larger is also possible in consultation with RDM Support
preservation_storage.File formats: All file formats accepted, but please use preferred file formats: https://dans.knaw.nl/en/file-formats/
preservation_storage.Versioning: Yes. A new version number is registered with each new version of the published dataset.
preservation_storage.Longterm storage: Intended for long-term preservation (min. 10 years) and publication
preservation_storage.Data citation: Each dataset receives a DOI which can be used to refer to the data package.

preservation_storage.name: Zenodo
preservation_storage.Purpose: General-purpose repository for all research output
preservation_storage.Sharing and Collaboration: External sharing. Access levels: open, restricted, closed, embargoed
preservation_storage.Storage capacity: 50 GB per dataset. For larger storage, contact Zenodo support
preservation_storage.Data sensitivity classification: Basic: do not store personal data on Zenodo
preservation_storage.Back-ups & Recovery: Data files and metadata are backed up nightly and replicated into multiple copies in the online system.
preservation_storage.Versioning: When you publish an upload on Zenodo for the first time, two DOIs are registered: one representing the specific version of your record, and another representing all of the versions of your record. Afterwards, a DOI s registered for every new version of your upload.
preservation_storage.Longterm storage: Files are retained for the lifetime of the repository
preservation_storage.Metadata: Stored internally in JSON-format, and is exported in several formats such as MARCXML, Dublin Core, and DataCite (according to the OpenAIRE Guidelines)
preservation_storage.Search engines harvesting?: All metadata is exported via OAI-PMH and can be harvested. Indexed to Datacite servers, and Zenodo search engine allowing other search engines to harvest
preservation_storage.Available licenses: Many licenses available, including creative commons and custom.
preservation_storage.Data citation: Yes- By default displays all citations for your records in Zenodo. Citation sources include: NASA,Datacite and Crossref

preservation_storage.name: Open Science Framework(OSF)
preservation_storage.Storage type: Data repository for project management and data publication
preservation_storage.Purpose: Project management interface which also integrates with external storage solutions and supports adding licenses, a DOI and file metadata to files and folders.
preservation_storage.Sync to Client: There is a python library osfclient to interact with files stored in OSF: https://osfclient.readthedocs.io/en/latest/index.html
preservation_storage.Sharing and Collaboration: Project can be private or public. Private projects can only be viewed and edited by project members. Public projects can be viewed by anyone and edited by project members. You can also create a private URL.
preservation_storage.Storage capacity: 5 GB for private projects, 50 GB for public projects. If you need more you can store data in an external, supported solution and link that solution to your OSF project.
preservation_storage.Data sensitivity classification: Basic: do not store personal data on OSF
preservation_storage.Storage location: Servers in USA, Germany, Canada or Australia
preservation_storage.Versioning: OSF maintains a record of file versions. You can view all earlier versions of a file.
preservation_storage.Available licenses: Several creative commons and commonly used software licenses: https://help.osf.io/article/148-licensing

preservation_storage.name: DRACO UMCU
preservation_storage.Storage type: Data repository for data archiving and publication
preservation_storage.Costs and eligibility: Free for UMCU but contact data manager

preservation_storage.name: Figshare
preservation_storage.Storage type: Data repository for data archiving and publication
preservation_storage.Purpose: Making research outputs available in a citable shareable and discoverable way
preservation_storage.Sync to Client: You can use the Desktop uploaderto drag and drop files onto to your desktop
preservation_storage.Sharing and Collaboration: Figshare intergates with a collection of apps for workflow collaboration e.g Bitbucket,Gitlab,Binder,overleaf,OSF. See lin(https://shorturl.at/fmKM3)
preservation_storage.Storage capacity: Free accounts on Figshare can upload files of up to 5gb and get 20gb of free storage.
preservation_storage.Maximum File size: >20 GB (to publish outputs larger than 20GB (up to many TBs) or files larger than 20GB (up to 5TB), consider Figshare+)
preservation_storage.Data sensitivity classification: Basic: do not store personal data on FigShare
preservation_storage.Storage location: hosted on Amazon Web Services , in the US or at local instition level based on based on type of access
preservation_storage.File encryption: Yes via intergation with encryption softwares
preservation_storage.Back-ups & Recovery: Automatic backups data files and metadata are performed nightly. Immediate restore of content in case of deletion of a file
preservation_storage.Versioning: supports version control. DOIs are version controlled and publication dates are openly tracked.supports versioning for both items and collections. See link for editing and versioning(https://shorturl.at/lqv28)
preservation_storage.Complete data deletion: Yes only for items that are private.Anything set to public can only be deleted by an admuistrator or ask to unpublish. See Link(https://shorturl.at/ijyI8)
preservation_storage.Metadata: metadata schema uses common elements from DataCite Schema 4.4 and is documented in the API documentation. It can be mapped to standard metadata schemas.

preservation_storage.name: Dryad
preservation_storage.Storage type: Dedicated Data repository for data publication
preservation_storage.Purpose: to enable the open publication and routine reuse of all research data.
preservation_storage.Data sensitivity classification: Basic: do not store personal data on Dryad

preservation_storage.name: Mendeley Data
preservation_storage.Storage type: Dedicated Data repository for data publication
preservation_storage.Purpose: free and secure cloud-based communal repository for data sorage
preservation_storage.Data sensitivity classification: Basic: do not store personal data on Medeley Data

matrix_data.Local drive (either UU-managed or person: A device managed by UU or a Personal device not managed by UU.
matrix_data.USB/Portable Disk: Any available USB based storage (drive, stick, memorycard) used for storing data
matrix_data.ITS Basic Storage: ITS Basic storage is a storage solution for storing large amounts of data for a relatiavely low price. It is possible to access the storage via either O:\Research of O:\Archive (depending on the type of data).
matrix_data.U-drive (uses ProStorage): Personal fileshare available for all employees and students on UU-managed devices. It can also be accessed on non-UU devices using a manual connection. It can be accessed outside of the UU by using VPN.
matrix_data.O-drive (uses ProStorage): The O: drive is a shared filesystem available to all employees and students on UU managed devices. It can also be accessed on non-UU devices using a manual connection. It can be accessed outside of the UU by using VPN
matrix_data.Teamsite (Office 365): A Teamsite is part of Office 365's Sharepoint and offers an integrated collaboration environment. Store and share files with your team, edit documents with multiple people on the same time.
matrix_data.Teamsite extra Secure (Office 365): An extra secure version of an Office 365 teamsite. Similair to a regular Teamsite, however this environment is more closed. For example it’s not possible to synchronize files locally or to share files with external people.
matrix_data.Teams (Office 365): Microsoft Teams is part of Office 365 and offers an integrated collaboration environment. Store and share files with your team, edit documents with multiple people on the same time, chat with your colleagues, schedule online video calls, organize live events and make use of extra tools like a Wiki or Planner.
matrix_data.OneDrive for Business (Office365): OneDrive for Business is used for storing and sharing personal business files. You are the only one with access to these files, but access can be granted to colleagues or external people.
matrix_data.SURFdrive: SURFdrive is a personal cloud storage service for the Dutch education and research community, offering staff, researchers and students an easy way to store, synchronise and share files in the secure and reliable SURF community cloud.

matrix_data.Teamsite (Office 365): 5 GB by default, expandable to 1 TB
matrix_data.Teamsite extra Secure (Office 365): 5 GB by default, expandable to 1 TB

matrix_data.Teamsite extra Secure (Office 365): Retained for 93 days, separated data centers
matrix_data.Teams (Office 365): Retained for 93 days, separated data centers
matrix_data.OneDrive for Business (Office365): Local recovery and version control, files can be recovered for 93 days, separated data centers
matrix_data.SURFdrive: Local recovery until max 30 days, back-ups at separated locations

matrix_data.ITS Basic Storage: Yes, within UU. Access is controlled by the owner of the fileshare.
matrix_data.O-drive (uses ProStorage): Yes, within UU. Access is controlled by the owner of the fileshare.
